name: Protein Coffee Iced Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: No per-flavour figure published; the brand cites 160–240 mg across the iced latte line
summary: Australian protein coffee in a can: real brewed coffee on whole and skim milk powders, at 15 g of protein — third-highest we track, behind Projo and Slate. The protein comes from the milk itself rather than added isolate. Beforeyouspeak publishes no per-flavour caffeine figure, no nutrition panel and no can size for the US pack, so those columns stay blank until we check a can.
